1.web: May God be merciful to us, bless us, and cause his face to shine on us. Selah.
1.asv: God be merciful unto us, and bless us, And cause his face to shine upon us; [Selah

2.web: That your way may be known on earth, and your salvation among all nations,
2.asv: That thy way may be known upon earth, Thy salvation among all nations.

3.web: let the peoples praise you, God. Let all the peoples praise you.
3.asv: Let the peoples praise thee, O God; Let all the peoples praise thee.

4.web: Oh let the nations be glad and sing for joy, for you will judge the peoples with equity, and govern the nations on earth. Selah.
4.asv: Oh let the nations be glad and sing for joy; For thou wilt judge the peoples with equity, And govern the nations upon earth. [Selah

5.web: Let the peoples praise you, God. Let all the peoples praise you.
5.asv: Let the peoples praise thee, O God; Let all the peoples praise thee.

6.web: The earth has yielded its increase. God, even our own God, will bless us.
6.asv: The earth hath yielded its increase: God, even our own God, will bless us.

7.web: God will bless us. All the ends of the earth shall fear him.
7.asv: God will bless us; And all the ends of the earth shall fear him.
